PowerShell($env:PGPASSWORD="odoo"; $psql="C:\\Program Files\\PostgreSQL\\17\\bin\\psql.exe"; Write-Output "=== PERSONAS: groups with real members \(excl. system\) ==="; & $psql -h localhost -p 5433 -U odoo -d odoo19 -P pager=off -c "SELECT c.name->>'en_US' AS category, g.name->>'en_US' AS grp, count\(r.uid\) AS members FROM res_groups g LEFT JOIN ir_module_category c ON c.id=g.category_id LEFT JOIN res_groups_users_rel r ON r.gid=g.id GROUP BY 1,2 HAVING count\(r.uid\)>0 ORDER BY members DESC, category NULLS LAST LIMIT 18;")
